note: The headings list starts at 10.1, so the chapter-opening passages (P01 the "CHAPTER 10" heading, P02 which carries the chapter title, P03 figure and P04 lead-in) have no numbered heading; from_heading is "unsure" for that subtopic, and the chapter summary (P41) and exercises (P42), which range over the whole chapter, are attached to it so every passage is covered. Section 10.1 is long and mixes several distinct testable ideas (tissue culture, virus-free plants, somatic hybridisation, GMOs, Bt cotton, RNAi-based nematode resistance), so it was split into six subtopics; the Basmati-rice/biopiracy block under 10.4 (P37-P40) was separated from the general ethics and regulation passages because it is a self-contained named topic.
